sections.title: Hobby words as objects
sections.content: Hobbies are things you like, so they work like the food and clothes words: after *szeretem* they take *-t*. The words in *-ás* (*úszás*, *futás*, *kirándulás*) just add *-t*: *úszást*. The others follow the pattern you know: *film → filmet*, *zene → zenét*, *foci → focit*, *sport → sportot*. Use *a* before a consonant and *az* before a vowel: *a focit*, *az úszást*.
Say *az úszást* but *a futást*: *az* goes before a vowel sound (the *ú* of *úszás*), *a* before a consonant. And keep the accent: *úszást*, *futást*, *kirándulást*.
